description: SecureString.withSecureAccess uses fatalError for invalid UTF-8. Consider throwing instead for production resilience.
remediation: Replace fatalError with a throwing pattern or return Optional to prevent crashes from malformed data.

description: SecureString.reveal() uses fatalError for invalid UTF-8. Same concern as withSecureAccess.
remediation: Return Optional<String> instead of fatalError, allowing graceful degradation.

description: URLComponents construction uses force unwrap (!). While the URL is hardcoded, this pattern should be avoided for consistency.
remediation: Use guard let or try pattern for URLComponents construction, consistent with SecureURLConstruction pattern.

description: URLComponents with interpolated path uses force unwrap. ID injection possible if ID contains special characters.
remediation: Use URLComponents with proper path component encoding, following SecureURLConstruction pattern.
